// FR-066: registerTools wraps every executor in the guard this returns, so no tool author writes one.
export function createCrashGuard(options: CrashGuardOptions): CrashGuard {
  return (name, executor) => async (input, context) => {
    const startedAt = options.clock();
    try {
      return await executor(input, context);
    } catch (thrown: unknown) {
      if (abandoned(context)) throw thrown;
      await reportCrash(options, {name, errorName: errorNameOf(thrown), startedAt}, context);

      return crashResponse(name);
    }
  };
}

export type CrashGuard = (name: string, executor: ToolExecutor) => ToolExecutor;
